name: Unwip 0.12.1
body:
## Unwip 0.12.1

- **Scrivener import fixed for Scrivener on Windows.** Chapters now come across with all their text (it was only finding the binder before)
- Your own Scrivener **status labels** come across with their real names
- Scrivener **emoji icons** come across
- Your main **font and size** become the project's manuscript style
- Windows Scrivener font names (like *TimesNewRomanPSMT*) are turned back into normal fonts, including bold and italic faces
